Extra services

Insurance, signature and DDP.

← Help Center

Which extras can I request?

Insurance, signature on delivery and DDP. Tick them in step 3 of the booking form.

Are extras guaranteed when I tick them?

No. It is a request. Our team confirms availability and price before pickup.

Why declare the value of my goods?

Declared value is needed for customs and for any insurance or claim. Please state it honestly.
